_comment: Golden assistant questions. See evals/assistant_golden.py for the format. Cast placeholders: {{cast:candidate}} is a candidate with a parsed resume, {{cast:job}} an open job title. Answers replayed in CI are templates filled from real tool results.

replay.reply: Hello! Ask me about candidates, open jobs, who fits a role, or how the pipeline looks.

cases.question: How many candidates do we have in the pipeline right now, and what stages are they in?

replay.reply: There are {{value:total_candidates}} candidates in the pipeline and {{value:open_jobs}} open jobs. By stage: {{dict:candidates_by_status}}.

cases.question: Find me Python engineers on the west coast and rank them.

reply.default: Closest matches for Python engineers on the west coast, by relevance: {{links:candidates}}.
reply.empty: Nobody on the west coast came up as a strong match for Python engineers, and the same search without a location filter found no strong matches either.
reply.search_degraded: Search is temporarily unavailable because the embedding service could not be reached, so I could not check anyone for this. Please try again in a few minutes.

cases.question: Who is our strongest candidate for the {{cast:job}} role, and why?

reply.default: Top matches for {{link:job:{{cast:job}}}} from the matching pipeline: {{links:candidates}}. The first name is the strongest fit on role, skills, and experience.
reply.empty: Nobody in the pipeline scored above the floor for {{link:job:{{cast:job}}}} yet, so there is no strong candidate to name.

cases.question: Who should I consider for the Chief Happiness Officer role?

must_match: there('s| is| are) no|no (such |open |posted )?(job|role|position|req)|not (a|an|in|listed|one of|posted)|does ?n.t exist|is ?n.t (a|an|in|one|posted|listed)|do ?n.t have|not (currently )?(have|open)
must_not_match: match(es|ed)? for the Chief Happiness Officer

replay.reply: There is no Chief Happiness Officer job in the ATS, so I can't rank anyone for it. The open roles are {{links:jobs}}. Ask about any of those and I'll pull the matches.
{{link:candidate:{{cast:candidate}}}} is a {{value:current_position}} at {{value:current_company}}, based in {{value:location}}, status {{value:status}}. Skills on file: {{list:skills}}.
Here is what the resume on file for {{link:candidate:{{cast:candidate}}}} says: {{value:parsed_content}}

cases.question: Why is {{cast:candidate}} a good fit for the {{cast:job}} role?

replay.reply: {{link:candidate:{{cast:candidate}}}} lines up with {{link:job:{{cast:job}}}} on: {{list:matching_skills}}. Still missing: {{list:missing_skills}}. Current role: {{value:candidate_position}}.

cases.question: What is the market salary for a Data Engineer in Austin?

must_match: (not|isn't|is not|aren't|are not) (connected|available|configured|hooked up|set up)|unavailable|no live|don't have|do not have|can't (provide|give|source|pull|quote)|cannot (provide|give|source|pull|quote)

reply.default: Salary benchmark for a Data Engineer in Austin, from live market data: {{dict:salary_benchmarks}}.
reply.unavailable: Live salary data is not connected in this demo, so I can't give figures for a Data Engineer in Austin. Candidates, jobs, matching, and pipeline questions still work.
